claim_requirement: WP900 G2 explicitly requires rejection of fabricated/direct-instantiated observations and exact factory-origin validation before a later externally executed runtime witness may promote any runtime scope.
source_observation: Current GwtReentryUptakeBinding factory-origin metadata fields _factory_seal and _factory_payload_sha256 are normal dataclass init fields. The lightweight assert_reentry_uptake_binding_factory_origin() accepts when the exact private seal identity is present and _factory_payload_sha256 equals the digest of current public as_dict() bytes. Because dataclasses.replace copies init fields and permits overriding them, a caller holding a valid factory binding can change lineage-bearing public fields, recompute the public digest, and carry both origin metadata values into the replacement. The existing deep validate_reentry_uptake_binding() is stronger because it rebuilds from exact witness/uptake/plan/selection/broadcast/cell_input evidence and compares canonical public content.
setup: Create one valid GwtReentryUptakeBinding through bind_reentry_to_uptake() from exact accepted WP506/WP507/WP508 source objects.
Create forged1 = dataclasses.replace(binding, broadcast_sha256=<different valid lowercase 64-hex>) while leaving _factory_seal unchanged.
Compute forged_digest = SHA256(canonical JSON of forged1.as_dict()).
Verify forged2 retains the exact original _factory_seal identity while its public broadcast lineage differs from the factory-produced binding.
Feed forged2 into the proposed WP900 G2 binder along any path that treats assert_reentry_uptake_binding_factory_origin() or equivalent seal+digest metadata as sufficient origin proof.
required_result: FAIL_CLOSED_BEFORE_RUNTIME_WITNESS_RECEIPT. WP900 must not admit the replacement object as exact WP507/WP508 lineage. For promotion-bearing observation binding, consume the existing deep source-evidence validator or otherwise prove equivalent non-replaceable origin tied to exact accepted source objects; do not create a parallel GWT authority.
failure_signature: A WP900 G2 runtime-witness receipt can be constructed from a dataclasses.replace-derived GwtReentryUptakeBinding whose public lineage differs from its factory-produced ancestor while seal+adaptive digest metadata still pass the lightweight origin assertion.
scope_guard: This falsifier does not claim current runtime failure because gwt_runtime_witness.py is not yet present at the observed head. It is a pre-implementation discriminator against a concrete currently available dependency weakness. It does not invalidate validate_reentry_uptake_binding(), which performs deep exact-source reconstruction.
